name: State of Digital Signage Pricing 2026
note: Published list prices only; n/v = not verified by us; monthly billing unless stated; hardware, taxes and negotiated discounts excluded.

vendors.unit: per screen per month (dynamic volume pricing)
vendors.platforms: Windows, Mac, Android, Chrome OS, Raspberry Pi, iPad, browser
vendors.note: Enterprise adds proof of play, white-label, kiosk/touch, IoT, POS; priced by the public calculator

vendors.free: 1 screen (only while the account has exactly 1 screen); new accounts since Mar 2, 2026 get a 30-day trial of up to 5 screens

vendors.note: Limited storage on the free plan
Price page blocks some automated fetches; verified manually

vendors.entryName: Renewal: $20 per player per year; first year $35 per new player
vendors.unit: about $1.67 per screen per month from year two ($20 a year); $35 in year one
vendors.note: Verified 2026-09-19; over 50 screens is a sales quote; no Windows, LG webOS, Samsung Tizen native players (browser PWA only)

vendors.free: 1 screen, forever, with a ChannelOS banner on the screen; never flips to paid
vendors.top: Pro $8 yearly / $10 monthly; Agency $200 per month for 25 screens then $6 per screen
vendors.platforms: TV browser (Android TV, Google TV, LG webOS, Fire TV via Silk, any browser); Android TV APK from the vendor site
vendors.note: Verified 2026-09-19; Solo removes the banner; no vendor hardware

vendors.free: 10 screens as a 3-month free trial with a watermark on screens (terms: new customers only, may be modified or cancelled)
vendors.entryName: Home Basic (10 screens included, no watermark)
vendors.top: Business Pro $520 per month unlimited screens; Enterprise Plus $830
vendors.unit: $52 per month for 10 screens, then $6.49 per screen per month from the 11th (monthly billing only)
vendors.note: Verified 2026-09-19; until September 2026 the site advertised 10 free screens without a published paid rate

vendors.free: No cap, self-hosted (Xibo Cloud from $4.90 per display per month)

vendors.unit: free server; Xibo Cloud per display per month; paid commercial players when self-hosted
vendors.platforms: Windows/Linux players free; commercial players licensed

vendors.free: No cap, self-hosted, per Raspberry Pi
